context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 74: Four major features added and verified. (1) Alert Rule Engine: CRUD + evaluation + 30s background monitor during market hours. Rules like 'NIFTY > 24000 AND VIX > 15' can be created. (2) Permissions & Packages: 4 tiers (free/basic/pro/unlimited) with per-user feature costs and usage limits. (3) Fraud Detection: Haversine distance + impossible travel check (max 900 km/h air). Auto-suspends accounts with INR 2500 reactivation fee. (4) CRM Module: Two-way messaging between admin and users with broadcast support. FNO Dashboard now has 6 sub-tabs including 'Alert Rules'. Admin Dashboard now has 9 tabs including 'Permissions & Packages', 'CRM Messages', and 'Fraud Detection'. All iteration 73 regression tests pass (GZip, X-Response-Time, health check, etc.).
